title: Set up
text: Since $$x^2$$ is a repeated factor, write it as $$\frac{A}{x}+\frac{B}{x^2}+\frac{C}{x-1}$$.

title: Solve
text: From $$1=A x \left(x-1\right)+B \left(x-1\right)+C x^2$$, plugging in $$x=0$$ gives $$B=-1$$ and $$x=1$$ gives $$C=1$$. Matching the $$x^2$$ terms gives $$A+C=0$$, so $$A=-1$$.
